args.title: trellis-spa-special-indemnity-rider.docx
args.body:
TRELLIS BIOWORKS, INC. — PROJECT LATTICE
COUNTER-RIDER TO ARTICLE VIII (INDEMNIFICATION)
SHARE PURCHASE AGREEMENT — HALBERD HOLDINGS LP (BUYER) / TRELLIS BIOWORKS, INC. (COMPANY) AND THE SELLERS NAMED HEREIN
(Responsive to Wexler Bright LLP second-turn markup of Article VIII; drafted against execution draft v4)

The following is proposed as new contract text for Section 8.2(d) of Article VIII, to be inserted following Section 8.2(c) and before Section 8.3.

Section 8.2(d) Special Indemnity for Disclosed Matters.

(d) Special Indemnity for Disclosed Matters. In addition to, and subject to the limitations set forth in this Section 8.2(d), the Sellers shall indemnify Buyer against Losses arising out of or relating to the following matters only, each as disclosed on Schedule 3.14 (Litigation and Intellectual Property):

(i) Schedule 3.14 Item 1 — TTAB Opposition No. 91-284772, Lumenor Devices B.V. v. Trellis BioWorks, Inc., opposing registration of the Company's mark TRELLIGEN (U.S. App. Serial No. 98/415,882) (the "Trademark Opposition"); and

(ii) Schedule 3.14 Item 2 — the written demand of Bexley Clinical Partners LLC dated 3 April 2026 alleging assay lot failures under the 2024 Supply Agreement (the "Bexley Customer Dispute").

The indemnity in this Section 8.2(d) (the "Special Indemnity") shall not extend to, and the Sellers shall have no liability under this Section 8.2(d) for, any Losses arising out of or relating to any matter other than the Trademark Opposition and the Bexley Customer Dispute, including, without limitation, Schedule 3.14 Item 3 (the OSHA citation, Citation No. 1829445, concerning chemical-hygiene documentation at the Company's Norcross facility, which has been resolved by informal settlement and paid in full) and any other resolved, threatened, or future matter.

The Special Indemnity shall survive the Closing for a period of twenty-four (24) months.

The aggregate liability of the Sellers for Losses under this Section 8.2(d) shall not exceed Two Million Five Hundred Thousand Dollars ($2,500,000).

The Special Indemnity shall be subject to the Deductible set forth in Section 8.3(a), applied on the aggregate-basis, true-deductible terms of the execution draft v4; nothing in this Section 8.2(d) converts, or shall be interpreted to convert, that Deductible into a tipping basket. The Special Indemnity cap of $2,500,000 is a separate and distinct cap applicable solely to Losses under this Section 8.2(d): it is neither subject to nor limited by the general aggregate cap in Section 8.3(b), and it does not increase, supersede, or otherwise modify that general cap. The Special Indemnity shall be recovered in accordance with the order of recovery set forth in Section 8.5, with Buyer recovering first from the Escrow Amount and thereafter severally from the Sellers in proportion to their Pro Rata Shares. For the avoidance of doubt, nothing in this Section 8.2(d) relieves Buyer of the obligation to exhaust the Escrow Amount before recovering Special Indemnity Losses directly from the Sellers, and no Special Indemnity Losses shall be recovered from the Sellers except pursuant to this Section 8.2(d) and in accordance with Section 8.5.

END OF COUNTER-RIDER — Section 8.2(d)
